en:
I won't run anymore.
We'll settle this next time.

With my own Satsuki Clan forces and JUSTIS
combined, we'll utterly crush you fools!
Go ahead and try.

I'm old, too. You'll be in trouble if you
look down on this immature punk, I promise.
Y-Yes, sir!
So the true mastermind has finally arrived.
Joe. I'm sorry about this.

If we don't stop him, the youth of this city will
be at that fool's beck and call forever.

No matter what it takes, I need to
make sure that doesn't happen.
I'm really sorry.

I should be the one apologizing. I couldn't figure
out your true motive in all this... I'm a terrible friend.

Besides, I always believed you would
attempt to stop JUSTIS in order to help me.
You mean you planned my part in this, too?

More or less. I figured if you shook things up, Komei
and Satsuki would show themselves eventually.

That's why I forced you out of JUSTIS.
To make sure you had the motivation.

Man, you're incredible.
Are you a fortune teller or something?

Not quite. Not even I could foresee the
legendary Dragon of Dojima joining you.
Kiryu-san. My apologies for everything.

If it's all right with you,
I'd like to join your team.

I need to defeat that man.
I... I need to get my revenge.

Okay, then.
Let's take him down together.
Thank you very much, Kiryu-san.
All right. This next battle will be our last.

With the Kiryu Clan behind us,
we'll destroy them!
You two should get ready, okay?
Of course.

All right, our battle with Satsuki is finally here.
Are you ready, everyone?

This really will be the final battle.
I want to thank you all for trusting in me so far.
However, failure here means losing everything.

If they win, they'll carry out their plan to turn
the youth of this city into an army of criminal soldiers.
Under no circumstance can we let that happen.

We're going to win... And we're going to
drive them out of Kamurocho for good.

Its future rests in our hands. The young people here
should be out making friends, not committing crimes.
Kiryu-san... I'm so thankful I met you.
Same for me!
Now let's go. The final battle awaits!
Right. Kiryu Clan, move out!
There are so many of them.

I guess they're the combined forces of
JUSTIS and the Satsuki Clan, after all.
What's wrong? Are you nervous?

Not at all.
If anything, I'm excited.

I'm really looking forward to fighting
alongside my friend here again.
You better not slow me down, Joe.
I should be saying that to you.

Nice to see you, my Kiryu Clan friends.
Today is the day that all of you die!
Kamurocho will be taken by myself and Satsuki-san!
Dreams... Bonds... Admiration...

By outwardly espousing those foolish ideals,
we'll form the largest gang in all of Japan.

And as the first step toward that ultimate goal,
we'll be using you Kiryu Clan buffoons as a sacrifice!

Now then, the last dance is finally beginning.
Go! Tear the Kiryu Clan to shreds!
We have him on the ropes.
I've waited a long time for this day.
My grudge against you is finally going to be repaid.
There's still more of them.

Okada. You think you're the king of the world,
but you're just a little brat in the end.

You have no idea how dangerous the world
of men can truly be. I'll have to show you myself.
Just like I did so many years ago!

And as for this "justice" you guys talk so highly of...
You're going to see just how ineffective it really is.
You're going to pay for what you did.
I'm here to help, friend.

Heh... You two remind me a bit of
myself when I was your age.

Yeah. When you asked me to be the leader of
you kids, I thought it was just more trouble.

I wasn't into the idea of sticking my neck out,
but I did, because you made me want to.

You reminded me of the values I've always
held at my core.

The importance of friends, the justice within us...
They might sound childish, but they're vital.

I must have forgotten over the years, but those things
are clear to me again because of you. Thanks for that.

Even after this battle ends, make sure
you remember the value of those concepts.

Once you forget them, you tend to age a lot quicker.
Trust me on that.

Right! I'll remember both you and
the events of today, for as long as I live!

Then we'll have to make it a memory worth keeping.
Come on! Let's stop this madman in his tracks!

You wanna disband the Kiryu Clan!?
Are you being serious right now!?

Yeah. Not only did we beat JUSTIS,
but their mastermind Satsuki as well.

Thanks to Satsuki's arrest, the police have
managed to round up most of his followers as well.

It just doesn't seem necessary to continue on
with the Kiryu Clan at this point. Am I wrong?

Way too wrong! What're you thinking!?
The Kiryu Clan's where all of us belong now!
Really...?

Yeah, that's right! We can't just let it fade away
now that we've fulfilled our initial goal!

The Kiryu Clan's, well... I dunno how to put this...
It's like some kinda family to me!
Well said, Masao-kun.

I've gotta agree with him, Kiryu-san.
Let's keep the Kiryu Clan going for a while.

Kamurocho isn't known for its tranquility.
Another Satsuki or JUSTIS will sprout up eventually.

We can be a place to protect the youth from bastards
like that. That's why we need the Kiryu Clan to continue.

I want to build the organization Kazuchika
and I strived for. The original JUSTIS.
A team with justice at their side... JUSTIS...

Okay. If it's that important to you,
I'm okay with keeping the Kiryu Clan intact.

Hell yeah!
Thanks for understanding, Kiryu-san!
Kiryu-san! I love you!

We're gonna be part of something special
together for years to come, Kiryu-san.

Yeah. By the way, there's something I've
been wondering for a long time now.
What's that?

The spelling of JUSTIS.
I mean, shouldn't it be j-u-s-t-i-c-e?

Why'd you choose j-u-s-t-i-s?
It was intentional, right...?

Huh? Wait, did we misspell it?
Holy shit... That's lame...
What? You seriously just spelled it wrong?
Y-Yeah. We really messed up, Kazuchika.
I-I guess so.
Well, maybe Kiryu-san has it wrong...

My English is nothing to write home about,
but even I know that word.

It's pretty common in song lyrics, you know.
I'm sure I'm right.

How didn't anyone notice this before now!?
Good thing we disbanded JUSTIS then, huh?

Hey hey, what're you little idiots
chattin' about over here?
What's up, Yano?

Some of those mastermind guy's followers
and leftover JUSTIS shits're causin' some trouble.
So there're still a few left.

C'mon, Koji!
We're gonna crush 'em all!
Tranquilo! Chill out, guys.

Kiryu-san's our leader, remember?
It's his choice if we're going or not.
So Kiryu-san? Whaddya say?
We don't have much choice.
Looks like we have some garbage to clean up.

To bring our justice out into the world,
and to protect the youth of this country...
...Kiryu Clan, move out!

Kiryu-san, um... I really have to thank you
for coming to save me earlier.
It was nothing. I'm just glad you're safe.

Me too! Anyway, um... Joe-san and my brother
really forced you into this team thing. Sorry.

Yeah I don't mind, though.
I've already agreed, so I'll figure something out.

Although, this is my first time dealing with young
guys like this. How do I attract new members...?
Oh! I think the bartender would know!

He was the leader of a humongous team
back in his days as a thug on the street!
Huh... He sounds experienced.

Sachiko... How can you be so disrespectful?
I'm gonna have to sue you for slander, y'know.

But Kiryu-san said he needs to scrape
together some new members for his team.

Oh yeah? That's a cinch.
Just give 'em a good whack on the head!
You want me to hit them?

Heck yeah. Some of the kids around these parts
act like they own the goddamn place.

It's one of the flaws of the countryside. They all
think they're the strongest little shit around.
Ugh, so they're just puffed up idiots.

Yeah. I'm pretty sure they'll follow anyone
who can prove they're stronger, though.

So if you knock them flat on their asses, Kiryu-san,
I bet they'll follow you no questions asked.
Huh!? That's kinda violent, isn't it?

That's right. I'm not the young guy I used to be.
I can't just go around punching people nowadays.
I don't think you'll need to worry about that.
Why do you say that?

These guys'll come to you once
they see how strong you are.
Huh!? Are you sure!?

Kiryu-san, you're a damn skilled fighter.
That's clear as day to anyone with experience.

If someone who's itching for a fight catches sight
of you, there's no way they'll be able to resist.
You think so? I can't really tell.
Absolutely! Even I'm getting in the mood...
Huh? This is no time for that!

I'm just joking around! But seriously, try it out.
You'll find potential members all over town.

You used to live in Tokyo, right Kiryu-san?
I'm so jealous...

Tokyo's really an incredible place, huh?
It's so different from Onomichi...

Tokyo's such an amazing place.
Maybe I'll apply to universities up there...
Kiryu-san! Look after my brother again today!
Welcome, Kiryu-san!
Thanks a bunch!
Please come back soon.

Everything the bartender cooks up is so tasty!
He might look scary, but he has tons of skill.
Kiryu-san! Please take this!
Good luck out there!
Kiryu-san! What do you want to do today?
Huh? The shit you think you're looking at?

You look kinda strong for an old fuck, though.
Show me what you got!

Wh-Whoa... I had no idea people
that strong even existed...

I wanna be just like you, old man.
Please lemme be your apprentice!
Huh? What're ya lookin' at, old man?

Oh, you actually look pretty tough. I'm kinda bored.
How 'bout you help me kill some time?
You're damn strong...

Sorry 'bout that. Here, I'll fight for ya
to make up for it. Just forgive me, yeah?
Huh? Who the hell're you?

If you got something you want from me...
you're gonna have to fight me first!

H-Holy shit, you're strong.
I'm so sorry...

I-I'll do anything ya want.
Please teach me how to be stronger!

Sup, grampa?
You wanna pick a fight with me?

How 'bout that. I've been lookin' for
someone who'll make me break a sweat! C'mon!
I-I give. Just forgive me.

You're real tough, man. With you teaching me,
who knows how strong I'll get!

Hey, you. The hell do you want?
You trying to pick a fight or something?

Fine by me. I'm the strongest in all of Onomichi.
I'm gonna beat you to a bloody pulp!

Damn, that's some strength.
You're incredible. Admirable, even.

My motto's always been to follow anyone stronger
than me, so... I guess I'll be sticking by you for a while.

And who might you be?
Do you have a problem with me?

You have a strong air about you. I expect
you'll be a tough opponent. Fight me.

What impressive strength...
It appears I need far more training.

Would it be all right if I came to train under you?
I would love to grow stronger.
Look what we got here! Some kinda outsider, huh!?

Y'shouldn't be walkin' around here lookin' so tough!
Yer gonna have t'pay the price, with yer body!

What the hell are ya!?
Nobody in Onomichi's anywhere close t'ya.

Maybe I can get stronger if I join up with ya.
All right, my mind's made up!
Who're you? I don't recognize your face.

You look like you've seen a bit of blood
in your day, though. This should be fun... Let's fight!

You're strong, man. It's been ages since
I've enjoyed myself in a fight this much.

I bet I'll have tons more fun if I join you.
Sorry, but you'll be seeing a lot more of me.
Oooh. You look damn tough, man.

I've been real bored fighting weak shits lately.
Sorry, but you're gonna have to liven things up a bit!

I lost... Never thought I'd find someone
stronger than me in this small-time town.

Thanks for showing me the light, buddy.
I'll gladly help you out when you need it.
Oh? You've got a pretty tough-looking body.
Great. You're the perfect guy to test my strength with!

Holy crap... You're so strong.
I've gotta admit, I admire that.

I wanna be strong just like you.
How about you teach me the ropes a bit?
Hey, do you have a minute?
Can I ask you something?

I know this might seem random...
but do you want to join my team?
Then join my team.

Dammit. We couldn't break through their ranks.
Guess we should just withdraw for now, huh?
Let's regroup and try to take them on again soon.

Those guys are strong... They might've
really killed us if we hadn't run away.

Yo, Kiryu-san. Thanks for keeping an eye
on these punks. I appreciate it.
It's nothing.

I didn't think they'd actually end up
helping you out though, Kiryu-san.
